scope.authorizedWork: Read-only source extraction and sanitized technical contract preparation.
scope.implementationBoundary: A bounded offline parser may be prepared separately. This contract does not enable a UI route, API endpoint, database call, command writer, camera permission, print action, deployment or production acceptance.

sources.hashNormalization: SQL decoded from UTF-16 BOM, CRLF mapped to LF by TextIOWrapper, UTF-8 without BOM; complete statement/declaration including final LF, excluding GO. These are metadata-only fingerprints; SQL bodies are omitted.
sources.evidenceLevel: VERIFIED_STATIC_BYTES_AND_BINDINGS; engine documentation is identified separately; no live SQL execution

sharedControlMetadata.meaningBoundary: Literal values and bindings are verified. Callback order, transaction ownership of SaveContinue, Inx/RL consumer semantics and reload behavior remain UNKNOWN.

uiBinding.menuAuthority: All four source menu rows have isDisable=0. This is not proof of runtime visibility, role/action permission or branch/storehouse authority.
uiBinding.expectedPlacement: Dedicated child workflows inside the verified warehouse QR group, each bound to an existing selected document; no QR-to-search toolbar action. Route names and capability wiring require the route owner review.

sequence: The SQL engine binds arguments to their declared varchar/nvarchar types before the procedure body. This file does not qualify transport conversion, truncation or code-page parity.
Barcode NULL becomes empty. Remove every U+000D CR occurrence and then every U+000A LF occurrence, including internal occurrences; do not replace them with spaces.
Trim only U+0020 SPACE from both ends of the barcode. Do not collapse internal spaces or normalize Unicode.
DocumentID NULL becomes empty, then trim only U+0020 from both ends. CR/LF removal applies only to Barcode, not DocumentID.
Target and Action NULL become empty; trim only U+0020 at both ends, then apply SQL UPPER. CR/LF removal does not apply to these parameters.
Reject empty Barcode first, then empty DocumentID, then a Target outside the two source values, then an Action outside ADD/DELETE.

trimSemantics.doNotUse: JavaScript String.trim(), .NET parameterless String.Trim() or Unicode whitespace regex as a source-equivalent operation.

normalization.sqlComparisonBoundary: UPPER, CHARINDEX, string equality and membership are evaluated under SQL collation. Ordinal ASCII behavior is a bounded implementation profile, not proof of arbitrary Unicode/collation equivalence.
normalization.retainedBarcode: After global CR/LF removal and whole-string U+0020 trim, retain the barcode spelling and internal spaces. Do not reconstruct it from trimmed fields, uppercase it, normalize its Unicode, or replace its GUID text in the stored QRCode candidate.

classification.sourceRule: First five characters of SQL-UPPER(normalized Barcode) compare equal to PKG1; -> package branch; otherwise ordinary branch.
classification.asciiPrefixRule: ASCII PKG1; is case-insensitive because the source uppercases before comparison. pkg1;, PkG1; and PKG1; are package candidates.
classification.collationLimit: Non-ASCII, width/accent equivalence and other collation effects are unqualified. Do not implement broad Unicode case-folding or compatibility normalization.

ordinary.delimiter: ASCII semicolon U+003B in the bounded profile; source uses SQL CHARINDEX
ordinary.componentLengthWarning: The source assigns substrings to nvarchar(50) variables before its nonempty checks; it does not explicitly reject oversize components. A safe Web parser must report over-width input as outside the qualified profile rather than simulate silent truncation.

package.lengthSemantics: Source uses SQL LEN, which excludes trailing U+0020. Whole-barcode U+0020 trimming has already occurred. LEN versus UTF-16/Unicode scalar counts for non-ASCII remains unqualified.
package.guidSlice: SQL SUBSTRING at one-based position 6, length 36
package.conversion: TRY_CONVERT to uniqueidentifier; NULL conversion result is rejected.
package.canonicalGuidProfile: 8-4-4-4-12 hexadecimal digits, ASCII hyphens; hexadecimal letter case is accepted; no UUID version or RFC variant-bit restriction.

zeroGuid.syntaxOutcome: Valid canonical GUID candidate; the source has no all-zero prohibition.
zeroGuid.businessOutcome: Needs CF_QRPackageTbl lookup. Reject as not found/inactive only if that lookup says so; no lookup was executed.

package.conversionLimit: The canonical GUID subset is documented. No claim is made that a host UUID parser accepts exactly every SQL TRY_CONVERT form. The 41-length gate and 36-character slice must be applied before conversion; do not rely on SQL GUID truncation to accept an appended suffix. Braced, compact, URN and other host-parser formats are not part of this qualified profile.

lookup.deleteActiveRule: Inactive package may resolve; row must still exist
lookup.noClientInference: Item/lot/quantity/packaging cannot be extracted from the GUID or accepted from client overrides. A disconnected parser returns an unresolved package candidate.

package.packageIdentity: Use the converted GUID for package identity. Preserve normalized Barcode text separately.

facts: Barcode parameter varchar(250) is a byte limit, not a universal Unicode character limit.
DocumentID parameter varchar(50) is a byte limit.
Ordinary ItemID/ItemCode/Lot variables and stored item fields are nvarchar(50), measured as UTF-16 byte pairs.
Stored QRCode is nvarchar(200), smaller than the procedure Barcode parameter.
Stored QRPackageID in the two QR row tables is nvarchar(200), while the package lookup key is uniqueidentifier.
No explicit COLLATE appears in the three inspected table declarations; this does not establish effective database/column collation.
unknowns: Effective database collation/code page and driver parameter conversion
Non-ASCII round-trip into varchar; silent lossy conversion or truncation
Case/accent/width and trailing-space equality for DocumentID, ItemID, Lot and QRCode
Behavior of every noncanonical GUID textual form

rules: Accept only ASCII printable characters plus CR/LF for barcode input; CR/LF are removed by the source rule. Other controls and non-ASCII return unsupported/unqualified, never silently trim or transliterate.
Apply U+0020 trimming explicitly. Keep the original normalized barcode independently of trimmed ordinary components.
Reject over-width components (>50 UTF-16 code units) and normalized barcode (>200 UTF-16 code units), plus raw argument width >250 ASCII bytes; do not truncate.
If accepting a document argument in a disconnected helper, preserve source normalization and reject >50 ASCII bytes; document existence and authority remain unresolved.
Package parser accepts canonical 36-character GUID only, including all-zero and arbitrary version bits; returns needsLookup=true without claiming existence or quantity.
Ordinary parser may return quantity 1 as a syntax-derived candidate, never inventory availability or command success.
Do not choose an action or target from QR payload. They belong to the server-owned workflow and explicit user intent.
safeDisconnectedProfile.compatibilityNotice: These extra input guards narrow accepted input for safety. Report them as unsupported/outside-profile validation, not as a proven legacy rejection. Root must approve compatibility changes before a live writer.

preconditions.condition: ItemID and Lot nonempty, and ScanQuantity > 0
Existing parent document selected by fixed Target and DocumentID
ADD requires item+lot existence in SY_BalanceItemTbl
ADD requires positive SUM(TRY_CONVERT(decimal(38,10), detail.Quantity)) for document+ItemID+Lot
ADD package duplication check is scoped to its target QR table and DocumentID+QRPackageID, not global across documents/targets
ScannedQuantity + ScanQuantity must not exceed RequiredQuantity + 0.0001

transaction.outerTransactionPresent: Use savepoint CF_QRcodeStp_Save, not an independent commit
transaction.locking: UPDLOCK/HOLDLOCK on parent document and, for package, package row; reread quantities/package duplication after locking
transaction.catchBehavior: Rollback own transaction; otherwise rollback savepoint if committable, otherwise rollback transaction. Return MsgType=1.
transaction.limits: Static control flow only. Trigger effects, isolation interactions, host save ordering, rollback/timeout and concurrency acceptance are NOT_RUN.

writes: Insert one QR row into target-specific QR table with new UserAutoID, selected DocumentID, normalized Barcode, resolved/parsed fields, quantity and optional package/packaging fields
add.ordinaryRepeat: Same ordinary QR may be added repeatedly as separate quantity-1 rows until quantity guard rejects it.
add.packageRepeat: Same package GUID in the same target document is rejected.

delete.package: Delete matching DocumentID+QRPackageID rows after existence check; requires package lookup to have resolved even if inactive.
delete.ordinary: Delete TOP(1) matching DocumentID+QRCode row after existence check. Equality is SQL collation-sensitive; no ORDER BY selects a specific physical row.
delete.flag: Set parent isScanQRCode=1 if any QR row remains, otherwise 0.
delete.notFound: Return MsgType=1. If this procedure owns a committable transaction, it commits that transaction before returning the not-found result.

businessAndMutationSemantics.directEffectsBoundary: Direct procedure writes only QR tables and parent isScanQRCode. It reads document detail and SY_BalanceItemTbl; it does not directly post stock, mutate document detail quantities, or parse/store a serial/location field. Triggers and SaveContinue can still have other effects and remain unqualified.
businessAndMutationSemantics.quantityCaveat: Required/scanned totals are grouped by document+ItemID+Lot, with no StoreHouseID dimension. Do not infer per-bin/location/serial accounting.

shape.Msg: Unicode message text; may include document/item/lot, quantity values or ERROR_MESSAGE

success.ADD: Message reports addition and ScanQuantity as text

categories: Item/lot absent from positive document detail quantity
Scanned total would exceed required total

limitations: No typed HTTP status, stable machine reason code, operation receipt, inserted row id or authoritative post-write snapshot is returned by this procedure.
An outer transaction may still be uncommitted after a success message. MsgType=0 alone does not prove durable commit of the entire host operation.
Uncaught provider/binding failures can occur outside these result-set branches.
Do not expose raw ERROR_MESSAGE or document-sensitive text through a new public API without reviewed redaction.

idempotency.reason: Ordinary repeat scans are legitimate separate increments; package duplicates are a document business guard, not an operation receipt.
requirements: A separately qualified writer must bind an independent operation key to one explicit scan intent and its selected document/target/action.
Preserve original operation identity across timeouts/navigation and reconcile uncertain acknowledgement without replay.
Do not deduplicate all matching QR strings globally, or treat package duplicate rejection as proof that this client operation committed.

printMismatch.conflict: Two-part payload does not satisfy current ordinary three-part parser. Procedure/table belong to purchase detail while form is warehouse output.
printMismatch.disposition: Print remains disabled/unqualified. Do not silently replace with similarly named IV_StockOutputQRCodeReportStp.

syntheticTestRequirements.expect: U+0020 is trimmed. TAB/NBSP/BOM are preserved by the source normalization helper; bounded profile may separately report unsupported, not silently strip.
Ordinary syntax candidate; empty ItemCode is allowed by source.
Reject respective separator/item/lot rule, not fallback search.
With the same canonical GUID suffix, all are package candidates in ASCII profile; retain original normalized Barcode casing.
Unresolved package candidate, not invalid syntax.
Canonical hexadecimal syntax candidate; no UUID version/variant-bit restriction inferred.
Reject/outside canonical profile before lookup; no permissive host parser bypass.
Barcode omitted/NULL -> empty rejection; DocumentID/Target/Action have no declared default; explicit NULL becomes empty, never default action/target.
Test 50/51 component code units, 200/201 normalized QR code units, 250/251 raw ASCII barcode bytes and 50/51 document bytes. Unsupported must not be truncated.
Synthetic contract fixtures cover decimal(38,10), tolerance 0.0001, repeat ordinary scan vs duplicate package and target/document scoping. No claim of executed SQL parity.
Parser invokes no DB/network/storage/command, opens no camera, creates no route, does not alter list search, and never claims document/package existence or mutation success.
Separate authorized execution tests needed for denial/cross-scope/lock, concurrent scans, rollback/savepoints, lost ACK, no replay, flag readback and host trigger effects.
